entities.name: Symond Halm
entities.description: A Ravnican playwright of comedies who went into debt to the Orzhov kingpin Ilona.

entities.name: Ilona
entities.description: Orzhov cartel potentate and kingpin to whom Symond owed a debt.

entities.name: Lord Kazmyr
entities.description: Ilona's pet thrull who repeatedly warns Symond that Bilagru is coming.

entities.name: Bilagru
entities.description: Giant armored executioner with a double-bladed axe who collects Ilona's debts.

entities.name: Zandra
entities.description: Child commander whose history Symond wanted to dramatize.

events.summary: Symond, his backers gone, borrows from Ilona and signs a contract staking his life on his play.
events.quote: Ilona bid Symond to sign a contract that put his life on the line

events.summary: Lord Kazmyr tells Symond that Bilagru will come for him.
At the play's launch only a quarter of the seats are filled and Symond bolts.
events.quote: he noticed that only a quarter of the seats were filled

events.summary: Symond stabs a vedalken man to be put into an Azorius prison, but sees Bilagru on horseback.
events.quote: Symond stabbed the man in the chest with his sword

events.summary: Symond is imprisoned in an Azorius cell, where Lord Kazmyr again warns him.
events.quote: Symond was thrown into an Azorius cell

events.summary: Bilagru kills his way through the prison and reaches Symond's cell.
events.quote: Bilagru, blood-spattered and armored, filled the doorway.

events.summary: Bilagru tells Symond that debts must be paid and raises his axe.

relations.quote: The kingpin's pet thrull Lord Kazmyr
he was a debtor to Ilona of the Orzhov
